message:
Using `on:focus` to listen to the focus event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onfocus` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:blur` to listen to the blur event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onblur` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`token` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
